settings.subtitle: Daily cognitive support gummy
settings.lede: Many gummies are built on pectin and sugar. Cognition is set in 100% grass-fed beef gelatin instead: a richer, cleaner base with a dense, satisfying chew, carrying full, disclosed doses in every serving.
settings.checks:
100% grass-fed beef gelatin
No proprietary blends
Low sugar
Caffeine-free
Third-party tested
settings.inside_list:
Magnesium L-threonate (Magtein®) | 2 g
Citicoline | 500 mg
L-theanine | 200 mg
Vitamin B6 | 20 mg
Folate | 800 mcg
Vitamin B12 | 500 mcg
settings.other_ingredients: 100% grass-fed beef gelatin, fruit juice concentrates, fruit powders, natural citrus oils, ginger. Low-sugar sweetener system being finalized with our formulator.
settings.how_to: Cognition is one serving a day. The exact gummy count is being finalized with our formulator, and every 30-gummy jar has ten of each flavor.
settings.allergens: Made with 100% grass-fed beef gelatin, so Cognition is not vegetarian or vegan.
settings.formula_note: Target formula shown. Final doses, base, and shelf-life claims are confirmed through production and stability testing before launch.
